candidates.trace_description: 52-node authored fork/join teaching workload. This is not a captured claudecode trace. 32B/7B names denote declared dense macro geometries. Four 48-GiB devices and 100 TFLOP/s, 800 GB/s are analytical assumptions, not measured W7900D specifications. INT4 effective width 0.515625 includes declared GPTQ-128-like scale metadata; fused dequant and all quantized behavior are assumptions.

limitations: uncalibrated CPU model
single replica; joint prefill/decode service model
fixed KV pool; allocator fragmentation is not simulated
decode-first scheduling with mixed serving batches

limitations: uncalibrated CPU model
independent model replicas with replica-local KV, prefix cache, host pools and DMA lanes
routing uses arrived unfinished requests, in-flight references and resident prefix identities
requests remain on one replica; cross-replica migration and shared fabric contention are not modeled
routing, hashing and dispatch add no separately measured CPU or network latency
